## Load Data

```{r}
library(plastyr)
plastic <- load_data()
```

## Clean Data

```{r}
clean <- clean_plastics(plastic)
```

## Country Plastic Type Proportions

```{r}
country_plastic_prop(plastic, country_name = "China")
```

## Top Polluting Countries

```{r}
top_polluters(plastic, n = 5)
```

## Plot Plastic by Country

```{r}
plot_plastic_by_country(plastic, top_n = 10)
```

## Plot Plastic Types by Country

```{r}
plot_plastic_types(plastic, country_name = "China")
```

## Paired T-Test for Change in Plastic Totals Between Years

```{r}
plastic_year_change_test(plastic)
```
